description: Base de données multimodale transports publics en Bretagne - Korrigo- GTFS is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bretagne Mobilité. La base de données contient les horaires théoriques, arrêts, lignes des 24 réseaux de transports publics en Bretagne: Ar Bus sur la Communauté de Communes du Pays de Landerneau-Daoulas Auray Bus à Auray-Quiberon Terre Atlantique Belle-Ile-en-Bus à Belle-Ile-en-Mer Bibus à Brest Métropole BreizhGo (TER, Car et liaisons maritimes) Coralie à Concarneau Cornouaille Agglomération Dinamo à ... Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Transport - Mobilité. Its keywords are transport de voyageurs, transport interurbain, train express regional, ligne routière régionale, bus, car. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
